children: Fluence Energy Inc. (FLNC) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.

Effective September 1, 2026, the Company moved its principal executive offices to 2107 Wilson Boulevard, Suite 900, Arlington, Virginia 22201 from 4601 Fairfax Drive, Suite 600, Arlington, Virginia 22203. There is no change to the Company's telephone number. Future correspondence and communications to the Company from shareholders and others should be directed to this address.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1868941/000186894126000037/flnc-20260827.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1868941/000186894126000037/0001868941-26-000037-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
